notes.title: V2.2 Achievement Fix & Shader Update
notes.content:
In this update a few achievements which did not work were fixed. As soon as you start the "Survive Waves" mode you will get all the achievements which you previously deserved.

Shaders got a small change and improve visual quality.

We are currently working on an awesome new survival game, all the updates are in our  [url= https://discord.gg/ZuJaUum2Dn]Discord Channel[/url] (https://discord.gg/ZuJaUum2Dn)

Thank you for the bug reports! <3

Kind regards,
Thomas

notes.title: V2.01 - Bug Fixes, Speedrun Update, Weapon Skins Support
notes.content:
In this small update a few bugs were fixed:
- getting stuck in levels with many rocks on the ground
- Speedrun Logic was reworked and fixed
- Pause Functionality broke the game when pausing the game after dying

Additionally users are now able to purchase DLCs to upgrade their visuals. Two rifle skins are either unlockable by playing the game to a higher level or by purchasing it in the store.

notes.title: V1.7 Engine Update & Performance Fixes
notes.content:
With this update a new Unreal Engine Version is active with new performance features. 
The gameplay system had an update where player movement and gameplay mechanics were slightly changed.

notes.title: V1.6 Big CPU and GPU Performance Update
notes.content:
In this update almost all meshes got better fitting LODs for distances.
Also for the CPU side many calculations are removed or limited which occurred every frame.

Feel free to comment the improvements or leave helpful feedback! <3

notes.title: V1.53 Fixed Achievement System & Texture Settings
notes.content:
- 2 achievements were almost impossible to get
- Texture cost got reduced

notes.title: V1.52 Reflection Fixes & Game Bug Fixes
notes.content:
- LOD issues got fixed as well as reflection issues on the side of the screen.

- The Kraken navigation got a workover and should now work all the time. If not, please don't hesitate to contact me via the Discord Server.

- Japanese Font is thicker now for better reading.

Thank you all for your bug reports!

notes.title: V1.51 Russian Translation update & Performance optimized
notes.content:
In this update the russian translation has got a few changes and optimization is on a new level!

On my developer machine I can reach 120FPS now on highest graphics without Nvidia DLSS enabled at peak with 5120x1440 pixels resolution. In small areas the framerate drops to at least 85 FPS.

I hope I did everyone a favour playing Their Land! Tell me how it worked in the Discord Server! <3

If there are severe translation errors, also let me know at the Discord Server. Thank you!

notes.title: V1.5 Many more Languages with this update!
notes.content:

[*] Spanish

[*] Hindi
[*] Japanese
[*] Dutch
[*] Portuguese

I hope you all like the new update! Note that the new languages [b]only apply for the subtitles and in game interfaces[/b]. Let me know if there are severe translating mistakes! Since it is automatically translated content there may be small translation errors.

[b]Thank you all for your massive support in the Discord Channel![/b]

Kind regards,
Thomas

notes.title: V1.4 Final Performance Update & Small Bug Fixes
notes.content:
This update will be the final big performance update since every single considerable optimization method was used to reduce the frame cost. The game will even be playable on lower hardware than declared in the minimum requirements.

In order to keep your GPU not rendering as fast as possible the "Max Frame Rate" option was set to 60. If you set this to endless your GPU will try to produce as many frames as possible and this may be resulting in louder ventilation.

If there are critical bugs, please don't hesitate to reach out in one of the Discussion Forums here on Steam or in the Discord Channel! Thank you all!

notes.title: V1.3 Massive Performance and Visual Update
notes.content:
[b]What has changed?[/b]
- Selectable Direct X 11 or Direct X 12 options at startup
- Reduced CPU usage dramatically on NPC's and other actors

notes.title: V 1.24 Small Bug Fixes & Performance Boost
notes.content:
[b]Bugs:[/b]
- Lever in "The Crossing" always pickable
- Taisha's cloth is not bugged on lower graphic settings any more
- Changed difficulty a little in the last fight

[b]Performance:[/b]
- Changed burnable bush instances with graphics settings
- Shadow Setting "Mid" with higher performance and better visuals (Screen Space global illumination instead of Lumen)

[u]Thank everyone on the Discord Server for their Bug-reports! This really helps a lot to present you a better experience!! <3[/u]

notes.title: V 1.23 Massive Performance Update 4 & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[b]Performance:[/b]
- Lumen quality reduced in some areas
- Shadowing quality reduced in some areas

[b]Bugs:[/b]

notes.title: V 1.22 Massive Performance Update 3 & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Performance:
- reduces material cost
- optimized rain effects
- optimized Lumen & shadows
- implemented "Max FPS" setting to not force your PC to render max possible FPS
- reduced post processing effects

Bugs:
- Speedrun Lock-Puzzle forcing players back to the main menu
- reduced getting stuck in rocks
- simplified puzzles a little at the start of the game
- removed some invisible walls or exchanged them with meshes

I really hope the game now works on all computers who have the minimum declared hardware on the shop-page! I would love you to show me the effect with positive reviews! <3

Any future bugs can be reported on the Discord Server or via the steam community tab!
